# Stepper

Guide a user through ordered tasks with progress and eligibility rules.

## Usage

### Checkout

Move through an ordered checkout flow one available step at a time.

<ComponentExample component="stepper" scenario="checkout" title="Checkout" description="Move through an ordered checkout flow one available step at a time." :index="0" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="stepper" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="1" />

## Selection-indicator motion example

The selected trigger exposes `aria-selected="true"`. A pseudo-element can emphasize the current tab or step without adding another interactive element.

```css
[data-scope='stepper'][data-part='step'] {
  position: relative;
}

[data-scope='stepper'][data-part='step']::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  inset-block-end: 0;
  block-size: 2px;
  content: '';
  background: currentColor;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform 160ms ease;
}

[data-scope='stepper'][data-part='step'][aria-selected='true']::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='stepper'][data-part='step']::after {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

The ordered step list exposes the current step and associates each step trigger with its content panel.
